title: Slice 626931: [Expense Agent] Lost receipt workflow and document creation (November '26)
summary: The Expense Agent now allows users to submit expenses without a receipt by selecting a 'No Receipt' option, which generates a standardized document, attaches it automatically, and applies enhanced compliance controls through policy-based settings.
key_points: Adds a No Receipt option so an expense can be submitted when the original receipt is missing
A No Receipt Declaration report and management codeunit generate a standardized document that is attached as proof
New enums for compliance status and no-receipt type; such expenses are meant to be marked Non-Compliant and need approver review
Description specifies a policy setting (off by default) with amount and count limits
Expense, report line and posted line APIs and tables updated, with new API and rule tests
